text:
maria: Heads-up — starting a small routing probe for v1->v2 behavior at 15:00 UTC. Goal is to test tenant route hashing + console mapping before a wider rollout. I need telemetry labels and quota delta visibility set up.
kevin: copy. what header are we using to decide route? `X-Compat-Level` or the existing `Tenant-Route-Hash`?
maria: we want to try `Tenant-Route-Hash` for affinity and add `X-Compat-Level` as a soft hint that doesn't affect strict routing. That way console can show opt-in/opt-out counts.
sam: for quotas, do we treat v2 as a separate quota bucket or aggregate under the tenant commit?
kevin: separate bucket for now, otherwise sampling will be noisy. we can expose combined view in console analytics.
olga: Console needs a new column: "compat_hint" and a toggle to show routed-v1 vs routed-v2 rates. I can add a flag but need the telemetry field names.
maria: telemetry fields: `route_decision` (values: v1, v2, fallback), `compat_hint` (none|v1|v2), and `route_hash` (string). Add `quota_bucket` (v1/v2/merged).
kevin: ok. agree on names. sampling rate? we should sample 5% traces for the first 2 hours, then 1%.
sam: quota delta: project a +8% qps to v2 in probe — set soft limit alerts at +15% from baseline.
olga: will wire dashboard panels: routed fraction, avg latency by route, quota burn by bucket, and sample traces panel filtered by `compat_hint`.
maria: thanks. rollout plan: 15:00-15:30 probe to 1% of tokens, 15:30-16:30 increase to 10% if no error spikes, then pause and assess. auto-fallback to v1 on >=5% error rate or 2x latency.
kevin: code changes are in `route-service` branch `probe/compat-hint` — PR up. small header parsing + metrics emission.
kevin: snippet: ```
if (req.header('X-Compat-Level') === 'v2') {
  metrics.emit('compat_hint', 'v2')
  route = preferV2(route_hash)
}
```
maria: ensure the client-side SDK doesn't set `X-Compat-Level` by default. we want server-side decisions only for probe. add a flag `compat_probe_enabled` in tenant config.
sam: will draft alerting: Pager if quota_burn_rate > 120% for 5m, and SLO violations on tail-latency > 2x baseline for 2m.
olga: console toggle will be hidden behind feature flag `console.compat_probe_view` until we validate UX.
deploy-bot: deploy started for `route-service:probe/compat-hint` (sha: a1b2c3d). :gear:
kevin: quick check — telemetry tag `route_decision` should be indexed in our TSDB? we need cardinality controls.
maria: yes, only allow `v1/v2/fallback` values; `route_hash` will be hashed to reduce cardinality. store route_hash as `route_bucket` (16-bit).
kevin: perfect. i added a migration to emit `route_bucket`. PR updated.
sam: timeline noted. I'll be watching quotas and latency. ping @olga when dashboard panels are live so QA can validate traces.
olga: will ping when panels ready, aiming 14:45 UTC.
maria: thanks all. post your small blockers here. :thumbsup:
